Title: Requires the attorney general's law enforcement misconduct investigation office identify employees and officers with a practice or pattern of misconduct and requires a review of certain cases
Summary: Requires the attorney general's law enforcement misconduct investigation office identify employees and officers with a practice or pattern of misconduct, use of excessive force, or acts of dishonesty; requires a review of such employees' and officers' cases.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the executive law, in relation to requiring the attorney general's law enforcement misconduct investigation office identify employees and officers with a practice or pattern of misconduct and requires a review of such employees' and officers' cases
